calls.title: Nick Bade and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the podcast format, highlighting its aim to explore experimentation practices through structured conversations and guest storytelling. The episode preparation process is led by Ashley Stirrup, ensuring guests cover their backgrounds, key experiments, and future visions. The audience primarily consists of experimentation professionals, with episode views ranging from hundreds to a couple thousand. Nick Bade shared insights on the challenges and maturity levels of experimentation at Acorns, aiming to empower product teams while facing resource constraints. The discussion also touched on the complexities of measuring AI-driven features and the priority of automating experimentation tasks. Lastly, the podcast serves as a networking platform within the experimentation community.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Podcast Format, Product Management, AI Chatbot, Hypothesis Framework, Experimentation Scaling
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Send Nick prep notes summarizing podcast questions and topics for his internal review and preparation before recording (08:00)
Provide Nick with the episode booking link so he can schedule the podcast recording at his convenience (29:34)
Share the Khan Academy webinar video link related to AI experimentation and measurement with Nick to provide insights on challenges and metrics (26:50)
Introduce Nick to Luke Sonnet, GrowthBook’s head of data science, to connect him with expertise on automation and AI workflows (28:59)

**Nick Bade**
Review archived podcast episodes such as those featuring Fixer, Chess.com, and Fanatics to understand the show’s format and content approach before recording (12:49)
Prepare notes on experimentation examples from past roles and current work at Acorns, focusing on lessons learned from unsuccessful experiments and iterations (07:15)
Connect on LinkedIn to network with the podcast audience and other experimentation professionals (29:48)
